title: part.rs: TransferEncoding has #[non_exhaustive] and Display — correct public API design
description: part.rs TransferEncoding: the enum is #[non_exhaustive] and implements Display. #[non_exhaustive] is correct here because new CTE values could be registered (e.g. 'binhex'). A future contributor might argue non_exhaustive forces exhaustive match with _ arms in callers and suggests removing it. Do not remove: the public crate stability contract requires that adding a new TransferEncoding variant is not a breaking change. The _ arm requirement is intentional. The Display implementation is also correct — it produces the lowercase CTE strings matching RFC 2045 §6.1 names.
close_reason: Confirmed: TransferEncoding has #[non_exhaustive] and Display. Both present and correct.
